issue.title: sonic-mgmt repo not found in sonic-mgmt docker

failure.body:
**Description**
Following the testbed setup instructions from github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/doc/README.testbed.Setup.md.
Successfully built the sonic-mgmt docker image.
But when the image is run, the sonic-mgmt repository is not included

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
    1.git clone --recursive https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage.git
      make configure PLATFORM=generic
      make target/docker-sonic-mgmt.gz
    2.  docker load -i target/docker-sonic-mgmt.gz
       docker run -it docker-sonic-mgmt bash
       cd ~/sonic-mgmt

**Describe the results you received:**
    caglab@d77ec686523e:~$ cd /var
    caglab@d77ec686523e:/var$ ls
    backups  cache  caglab  lib  local  lock  log  mail  opt  run  spool  tmp
    caglab@d77ec686523e:/var$ cd caglab
    caglab@d77ec686523e:~$ ls
    azure-cli_bundle.tar.gz  azure-cli_bundle_2.0.10  bin  env-201811  lib

**Describe the results you expected:**
I expected to see the directory /var/caglab/sonic-mgmt

We recently removed the `sonic-mgmt` directory from the `docker-sonic-mgmt` build as it increases the size of the docker image and people typically use their own copy of `sonic-mgmt` to work with the management docker anyways.
